title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Ice Cream Pie
changes_from_base: A pressed chocolate-chip biscuit crust filled with two layers of bought chocolate ice cream and a hot fudge middle, instead of sponge layers.
summary: A no-bake chocolate ice cream pie with a crisp biscuit crust and a ribbon of hot fudge running through the middle.

ingredients.item: crisp chocolate chip biscuits, frozen for 20 min
fine sea salt or table salt
chocolate ice cream, divided (475 ml + 475 ml)

steps.title: Melt
steps.text: Melt 85 g unsalted butter over medium-low heat and leave to cool until liquid but no longer hot, about 15 min.

steps.title: Crush
steps.text: Pulse 200 g frozen chocolate chip biscuits to fine crumbs, setting aside 1 tbsp for decoration, then stir the rest with the melted butter and ⅛ tsp salt using a spoon so the chocolate chips do not melt.

steps.title: Press
steps.text: Press the crumb mixture over the base and up the sides of the pie dish and freeze for at least 30 min until firm.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Spread 475 ml chocolate ice cream over the crust and freeze for at least 1 h.

steps.title: Fudge
steps.text: Dot 120 ml hot fudge sauce over the ice cream in small spoonfuls, spread evenly and freeze for at least 1 h.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Spread the remaining 475 ml chocolate ice cream over the fudge layer, cover with baking paper and freeze for at least 4 h, ideally overnight.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Stand the pie for 5 min, scatter sprinkles around the edge and the reserved crumbs in the centre, then cut into wedges.

tips: Mix the crumb crust with a spoon rather than your hands so the chocolate chips stay intact.
Let each ice cream layer firm up in the freezer before adding the next so the fudge stays as a distinct ribbon.
Leave the pie to stand for 5 min at room temperature before slicing to make cutting easier.
storage: Covered tightly, the pie keeps in the freezer for up to 1 week.
